About the Institution

The National University of Singapore is a national public research university in Queenstown, Singapore. Founded in 1905, it is the oldest autonomous university in Singapore. It is consistently ranked among the top 10 universities in the world.

Campus Life & Student Culture

NUS offers a modern, high-tech campus environment in Kent Ridge. Students reside in historic Halls of Residence or modern residential colleges, featuring state-of-the-art academic libraries, sports facilities, and cultural theaters.

Total Enrollment42,000+
International Ratio30%
